_doc: lint exceptions (each with a reason) and backlog before A2 (known, fixed in B1). match: field → RegExp against rule, file, text. Change known only via --write-known and with a reason in the commit.
_galleryModules: Helpers, not UI building blocks: pure input and filter logic (validation, number parsing, day presets, filter matching and chip texts; the controls that use it are in the gallery), DOM helpers, hash router, overlay layer (internal, used by menu/toast/tooltip/dataCard), i18n layer (t, setLocale …, visible in the gallery as the language switcher), formatting (formatting is described in the gallery under “Data source”, but not per function). js/version.js only exports the version string (no UI).

exceptions.reason: The 1 px hairline is part of the look and not worth a size token.
Full viewport size is not a design size.
visibility is discrete (no intermediate frame); the 0 s transition only delays hiding until after the opacity fade.
Exported as error() and shown that way in the gallery.
hideTooltip is a helper for tooltip(), scale is chart math (tests in tests/charts.test.mjs).
Behaviour, not animation: refresh the data-age display every 15 s (shell.js).
